sites.downstream: main prints result.object, blank line, Token usage: result.usage and Finish reason: result.finishReason; main().catch(console.error) preserves error reporting.
sites.reason: One short English plot is classified into five closed genres. No generation, arithmetic, extraction, multimodal state or multi-hop reasoning. Diagnostics are metadata, not generated reasoning. Real Jev usage can map to the consumed token fields and completed decisions to adapter-owned generic stop. No adversarial mitigation exists; suitability does not extend to hostile public inputs.

options.benefit: Replace the one enum inference with confidence-gated Jev; accepted decisions may reduce latency/cost by avoiding generative inference. Expected cost is Jev cost plus fallback fraction times original cost; serial misses add latency and cost. Preserve all four stdout calls with truthful metadata.
options.risk: Genre ambiguity and uncalibrated confidence can disagree with GPT-4o-mini. Keep original on missing key, low confidence, invalid metadata, transport error, timeout or rate limit. Initial threshold 0.9 is provisional.

options.benefit: Preserve current model and diagnostics with no added call latency; no speculative savings.
options.risk: No Jev savings; existing classification ambiguity remains.
